name: @core/data
summary: Data-driven animation: charts, bar races, maps and networks from JSON/CSV.
guide:
Feed data inline, as CSV text, as "asset:<id>" (JSON or CSV upload) or from composition params ("{{params.sales}}"). Scenes: data:chart-story {title, data, kind, category, value, series, prefix, suffix, highlight, steps, caption}, data:race {title, data, time, top}, data:map-story {title, data, points, routes, focus, zoom, time, projection}, data:network {title, nodes, edges, layout, pulses, chain}.
Raw layers: {"type":"chart", "kind":"bar|hbar|stack|line|area|pie|donut|scatter|race", "data", "category", "value", "series", "time" (one snapshot per value → morphs/race), "steps":[{"at","data"}], "fields" (scatter x/y/r/label/group), "highlight", "prefix", "suffix", "decimals", "compact", "grow", "stagger"} · {"type":"map", "data":[{"country","value"}], "points", "routes", "focus":"Europe"|["France"], "zoom":[{"t","focus"}], "projection", "spin"} · {"type":"graph", "nodes", "edges", "layout", "pulses":[{"path","at","repeat"}], "highlight":[{"nodes","at","d"}]}.
Countries accept English or French names ("Allemagne", "USA") and ISO numeric ids.
